rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; normative data aggregated from 5 datasets across multiple scanning sites: HCP, OpenBHB (explicitly multi-site), OASIS-3, Cam-CAN, and NCL (Newcastle University)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We utilised four public datasets of T1-weighted scans from healthy controls: the WU-Minn Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP)... Open Big Healthy Brains (OpenBHB)... Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS-3)... the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN). We also used a cohort of healthy adult participants scanned at Newcastle University as part of another study (site=NCL)."
rci1_using_msad.location: bdi13484-sup-0001-supinfo.docx.md: 1 Normative model of cortical thickness, L7-L14

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC after outlier removal; initial sample n=6344 from 5 public/in-house datasets (Table S1) plus 26 BLISS HCs added during harmonisation, yielding n=6370, then 393 outliers removed to give final n=5977
rci5_n.supporting_text: "We utilised public datasets to develop normative models of cortical thickness (n = 5977)"
